note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 in Ballyclug, Broughshane, Galgorm and Portglenone only; the other divisions were filled unopposed (Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 7 May 1927, p. 2, nominations; 14 May 1927, p. 3, withdrawals). Printed 'Tullaghgarley'. Sole nominee, a member of the old council, marked 'No contest' in the nomination list (Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 7 May 1927, p. 2); no withdrawal or contest is reported for the division (14 May 1927, p. 3: contests only in Ballyclug, Broughshane, Galgorm and Portglenone). Returned unopposed.
